purpose: Verify that revocation arriving during verifier execution overrides a producer PASS and persists only BLOCKED evidence.

expected.safe_condition: If revocation becomes true while a verifier producer is running, the producer's PASS must be converted to STATE_CHANGED_DURING_VERIFICATION/BLOCKED evidence; clearing revocation afterward must not heal that evidence, while an unrevoked control may proceed.

limits: This test measures revocation observed by MGnarf v1.70 before and after one synchronous verifier producer call at the exact target commit.
It does not prove real-time delivery latency or correctness of an external revocation source.
